en: Vintage black‑and‑white studio portrait of a seated woman in an ornate light-colored gown with lace details, long gloves, and multiple rings, draped in a fur-trimmed cloak. She leans her head on one hand and gazes toward the camera. The background is plain, and the image has a narrow border typical of early photographic postcards. At the bottom is the printed name "AINO ACKTÉ," and along the left edge in small letters appears "ALBIN, PARIS."
